name: geostack
description: The GeoStack skill tree: each library's use skills, installed together with the skills of the libraries it builds on.

plugins.name: geostack
plugins.description: The root of the GeoStack skill tree: the role ladder (structure, primitive, strategy, model, algorithm, step, recipe) that every library's skills are written in, and the standards for a library's README and its documentation figures, drawn in geostack.

plugins.name: finitevolx
plugins.description: Write finite-volume ocean and atmosphere models in JAX on finitevolX — Arakawa C-grids with ghost rings, raw stencils and difference / interpolation operators, WENO / TVD advection, land-sea masks with coastal stencil fallback, boundary conditions, diagnostics, forcing, spectral / CG / multigrid elliptic solvers and SSP time steppers — instead of hand-writing shifted slices, ghost-cell fills, Poisson solvers and Runge–Kutta loops.

plugins.name: gaussx
plugins.description: Write structured linear algebra and Gaussian code in JAX on gaussx — Kronecker / block / low-rank / banded / sparse operators, structure-aware solve / logdet / Cholesky, Gaussian distributions, GP, Kalman and quadrature recipes — instead of re-implementing them with dense jnp.linalg.

plugins.name: geonnax
plugins.description: Write geoscientific neural networks in JAX on geonnax — Fourier / spherical / wavelet neural operators, dimension-flexible U-Nets, SIREN and multiplicative filter networks with FiLM and hypernetwork conditioning, lon/lat and spherical-harmonic encoders, spectral and localized bases with their eigenvalues or geometry, random Fourier features, spectral normalisation, SNGP heads and other deterministic cores for uncertainty-aware models — instead of hand-rolling FFT convolutions, spherical harmonics, sine-network inits and random features.

plugins.name: geotoolz
plugins.description: Build geospatial pipelines on the geotoolz stack — find and index files (geocatalog), read EO products (geoproducts), tile and stitch (geopatcher), compute (geotoolz), object storage (geocloud) — instead of re-implementing them.

plugins.name: kernellib
plugins.description: Write kernel methods in JAX on kernellib — kernels as Equinox modules, Gram matrices as gaussx operators, matrix-free and preconditioned solves, random-feature and Nyström approximations, kernel ridge regression at scale, HSIC / CKA / MMD tests, graph kernels and eigenmaps — instead of hand-rolling distance matrices, Cholesky solves and random features.

plugins.name: pyrox
plugins.description: Write probabilistic models in JAX with Equinox and NumPyro on pyrox — modules that own their sample / param sites, kernels with priors and guides, exact / sparse / Markov / multi-output GPs, Bayesian layers, ensemble MAP / VI, latent Gaussian models with INLA — instead of hand-wiring numpyro.sample into Equinox modules.

plugins.name: spectraldiffx
plugins.description: Write pseudospectral code in JAX on spectraldiffx — Fourier, Chebyshev and spherical-harmonic grids, spectral derivatives with correct dealiasing, DCT / DST transforms, Poisson and Helmholtz solvers with per-axis boundary conditions, masked-domain capacitance solves and spectral filters — instead of hand-rolling wavenumbers, FFT tricks and divide-by-k² solvers.

plugins.name: xtremax
plugins.description: Write extreme value analyses in JAX and NumPyro on xtremax — GEV, GPD, Gumbel, Fréchet and Weibull as NumPyro distributions that work in NUTS and SVI, stable densities, quantiles and return levels through ξ = 0, non-stationary return levels, temporal / spatial / spatiotemporal point processes (Poisson, renewal, Hawkes, marked, thinned) as equinox operators and NumPyro likelihoods, and xarray block maxima, thresholds and declustering — instead of hand-rolling EVT formulas, Poisson likelihoods and extraction code.
